reviews.body: Looks good! Can you add the new test:node script to the continuous-integration workflow?

comments.body:
awesome! 
Thoughts: This should probably not be in a bugfix release as it changes important meta-data. Even though this was buggy before, there were cases (or workarounds in place) where this worked and this could now break.

Also: can we also test proper typescript tsc --noemit?

Agreed that this metadata change should wait for a release beyond a bugfix release. Added `tsc --noEmit` consumer checks for Node16, NodeNext and Bundler resolution, including the named export, options and jsPDF augmentation. All six Node/TypeScript consumer tests pass, as does the repository typecheck. The consumer type checks cover ESM imports; the existing CommonJS check covers runtime loading.

No version bump is included; release scheduling remains with the maintainers.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
